name: Beck Nolan
bio: Beck Nolan is an American actor.

credits.title: Line Cooks
credits.overview: A sheltered, straight-A recent high school grad breaks out of her shell while working a summer job at a local Korean-Mexican fast food fusion joint run by teenagers and ex-cons.

credits.title: Mouse
credits.overview: In 2002 Arkansas, Callie and Minnie’s friendship is suddenly upended the summer before their senior year of high school. Left rudderless without her best friend, Minnie forms a complicated bond with Callie’s mother.

credits.title: Slay
credits.overview: A killer on the loose targets a group of teenagers on spring break.

credits.title: Loafers
credits.overview: Best friends Isaac and Cameron face life after college as they navigate love triangles, complicated friendships and the deeper question of whether their friend group can survive adulthood.

credits.title: Good Guy with a Gun
credits.overview: Follows a young man who after his father is murdered starts making bad choices, goes through life-threatening consequences and, of course, gets into guns.

credits.title: Desire: The Short Films of Ohm
credits.overview: Collection of six short films from director Ohm Phanphiroj. Includes his acclaimed "Desire" trilogy (The Deaf Boy's Disease, The Space Between Us, and The Last Kiss) as well as three self-starring documentary films (Journey, The Meaning Of It All, and The First Conversation Between Frank And I).

credits.title: The Last Kiss
credits.overview: Ant and Tremor meet up in a hotel lobby in downtown Chicago. Tremor is moving to Florida tomorrow, so this is the last chance they have to express their feelings for each other.

credits.title: The Deaf Boy's Disease
credits.overview: Ant starts to wonder about his sexuality when he meets deaf teenager Early. His friend Tremor picks up on Ant's interest and begins to tease him, leading to some very awkward but revealing conversations.
